The '''Trader's Causeway''' was busy mercantile roadway located in the pirate town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trader's Causeway appears as an area on Rishi in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.<ref name="SWTOR" />
